title: Original engineering fixture on deterministic synthetic data

hypotheses.claim: The original engineering note defines close / open - 1.
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: No predictive economic mechanism is claimed. This definition is used to exercise the software pipeline.
hypotheses.signal_direction: Higher values are long under a local demo convention only.
assumptions: The cited document is an original engineering fixture, not academic research.
Data are entirely synthetic; metrics are not evidence of investment performance.
Daily close is available after the session closes; the local label enters at the next open and exits at the following open.
The long direction is a local demo convention and no predictive relationship is claimed.
This is factor evaluation without transaction costs, slippage, borrowing, or a complete execution model.
